# activedirectory_ou (Data Source)

Look up an organizational unit by GUID or DN. Errors if it does not exist.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look up a single organizational unit by GUID or distinguished name. Exactly
# one identity attribute must be set; the lookup errors if the OU is absent.
data "activedirectory_ou" "staff" {
  dn = "OU=Staff,DC=corp,DC=local"
}

output "staff_guid" {
  value = data.activedirectory_ou.staff.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `dn` (String) Look the object up by distinguished name.
- `guid` (String) Look the object up by objectGUID.

### Read-Only

- `container` (String) Distinguished name of the parent.
- `description` (String) Free-text description.
- `id` (String) The objectGUID.
- `name` (String) The OU's name (RDN).
- `protected_from_accidental_deletion` (Boolean) Whether the OU is protected from accidental deletion.
